# Cognita Mindcare

> Affordable online therapy and life coaching across India, based in Bengaluru. Evidence-based, confidential. Founded by Veroanica, psychologist and life coach. First 30-minute session is free.

## Services
- [Therapy](https://cognitamindcare.com/therapy.html): Counselling for anxiety, stress, relationships and life transitions. Online (Zoom) across India, in person in Bengaluru.
- [Psychology internship](https://cognitamindcare.com/internships.html): Online internship with real case exposure, CBT/REBT training and certificate.

## About
- [About](https://cognitamindcare.com/about.html): Who Veroanica is, approach and background.
- [Contact / book a free session](https://cognitamindcare.com/contact.html): Free 30-minute intro session, Bengaluru or online.
